title: Trajectory-Guided Fault Localization for Agent Skill Evolution
title_zh: 面向智能体技能演化的轨迹引导故障定位
abstract_en: Agent skills provide reusable guidance for code agents, but incomplete or unsuitable guidance can impair task execution. To reduce the manual effort of skill refinement, recent approaches use LLMs to generate revisions from execution feedback. However, grounding these revisions in explicit behavioral evidence remains challenging. To address this gap, we propose SkillMorph, a skill-evolution approach based on trajectory-guided fault localization in agent skills. Its core idea is to link execution evidence to specific skill contents before generating revisions. Specifically, SkillMorph compares failure and success evidence in abstracted trajectories across repeated runs and tasks, incorporating changes between evolution loops to identify suspicious actions. It then uses these suspicious actions to localize edit sites in the skills and generate corresponding revisions. Experiments on SWE-Skills-Bench and CannBot show that the skills evolved by SkillMorph consistently achieve higher trial-level accuracy and execution consistency than the original skills and those from four existing skill-evolution methods. We have also applied SkillMorph to automated kernel generation with an AI operator-development team, which has accepted 6 skill-revision pull requests.
abstract_zh: 智能体技能为代码智能体提供可复用指导，但不完整或不合适的指导会降低任务执行效果。现有方法通常利用大语言模型根据执行反馈生成技能修订，但难以将修订建立在明确的行为证据之上。为此，论文提出 SkillMorph，一种基于轨迹引导故障定位的技能演化方法。其核心是在生成修订前，将执行证据关联到具体技能内容。SkillMorph 在多次运行和不同任务中，对抽象化的成功与失败轨迹进行对比，并结合不同演化循环之间的变化识别可疑动作；随后利用这些动作定位技能中的编辑位置并生成对应修订。在 SWE-Skills-Bench 和 CannBot 上的实验表明，SkillMorph 演化出的技能在试次级准确率和执行一致性方面持续优于原始技能及四种已有技能演化方法。此外，SkillMorph 已应用于 AI 算子开发团队的自动化内核生成，并有 6 个技能修订 pull request 被采纳。
key_points_zh: 针对技能演化缺乏明确行为依据的问题，提出 SkillMorph 轨迹引导故障定位框架。
通过比较跨任务、跨运行的成功与失败轨迹，并分析演化循环间变化，识别可疑动作。
将可疑动作映射到技能中的具体编辑位置，再生成有证据支撑的技能修订。
在 SWE-Skills-Bench 和 CannBot 上，SkillMorph 在试次级准确率与执行一致性方面优于原始技能及四种基线方法。
在自动化内核生成场景中完成落地，AI 算子开发团队已采纳 6 个技能修订 pull request。

llm_assessment.comment: SkillMorph makes skill evolution evidence-grounded by localizing faulty skill content from contrasting execution trajectories before revision.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: SkillMorph通过对比执行轨迹定位技能中的错误内容，使技能演化在修订前获得明确的行为证据支撑。
